title: Telegram Expert 2025: New Features for Mass Marketing
description: Comprehensive overview of Telegram Expert's latest update: mass messaging tools, stories management, JSON generator, and an improved registration system.
text: Numbers E-mail's Select service Main Our blog Telegram Expert Update: 17 New Automation Modules Released Telegram Expert Update: 17 New Automation Modules Released Finding quality tools for working with Telegram has always been a challenging task. Most existing solutions are either overloaded with unnecessary functions or so complex that it takes weeks or even months to master them. That's why we're excited to announce an exceptional update from our partners — the Telegram Expert team, recognized leaders in Telegram automation. Over the past month, the developers have implemented a truly impressive update, adding 17 new modules that users have been desperately waiting for. The main advantage of the new features is their intuitive nature and ease of use. Contact Management Let's start with one of the most demanded areas — contact management. The new tools include: Mass addition of contacts via phone numbers or usernames Complete cleanup of the contact book when needed Quick deletion of selected contacts Automatic tracking of contacts used for messaging In the communications sphere, long-awaited tools for mass messaging and automatic inviting to supergroups have been introduced. The system automatically tracks processed contacts, which significantly simplifies working with large databases. Search and Analytics Global search has become much more functional. Now you can search for channels, chats, and users by keywords, getting unique results depending on account geography. This opens up new possibilities for precise audience targeting. Special attention should be paid to the new link checker tool, which works even without using accounts. It allows you to get detailed information about channels, groups, and users, including the number of participants, descriptions, and names. Account Management Account diagnostics has reached a new level. Now you can: Mass check account status Automatically sort them by category (active, blocked, in spam list) Export data even from blocked accounts Create backups of important information Bots and Automation Creating and setting up bots has become easier thanks to BotFather automation. Now you can quickly create bots, configure their names, descriptions, and set photos — all in just a few clicks. Content Management Content management capabilities have significantly expanded. A convenient tool for editing sent messages (within 48 hours) has been introduced, which also allows pinning important messages in chats. Integration with @postbot allows you to prepare posts for distribution in advance, including media content and interactive buttons. Stories Innovation One of the most innovative additions is the set of tools for working with stories: Publishing stories on accounts Ability to tag users with automatic notification sending Deletion of outdated stories Export of links for analytics Technical Improvements Special mention should be made of the new JSON generator — an indispensable tool for those who have faced problems with missing or incorrect JSON files when purchasing accounts. Now you can generate these files yourself, selecting the necessary parameters and specifying paths to session files. Registration Improvements The development team has significantly improved the registration system, achieving impressive results: Increased code delivery rate by 4-6 times Enhanced registration system stability Free use in the basic version Leading positions in the global market Bug Fixes and Optimization The update also addressed errors in various modules. For example, the link checking module now includes proxy support and improved stream management, which significantly increased operational stability. Update Benefits The updated Telegram Expert provides a truly comprehensive solution for professional work with Telegram. Key improvements include: Reduced blocking risks More lenient messenger response to mass actions Increased marketing campaign effectiveness Workflow optimization Conclusion Telegram Expert is becoming a truly indispensable tool for those who work seriously with Telegram. The new capabilities not only simplify work but also open new horizons for project development. Try the updated version now and see how it can increase your work efficiency and project profitability.
